sloka: निवर्तस्व सह स्त्रीभिः कथम् भूयो अनुगच्छसि ।सौहृदम् दर्शितम् तावत् मयि भक्तिः त्वया कृता ॥४-१६-६॥
transliteration: nivartasva saha strībhiḥ katham bhūyo anugacchasi ।sauhṛdam darśitam tāvat mayi bhaktiḥ tvayā kṛtā ॥4-16-6॥

translations.english: 'Go back with all the women of the harem. Why do you follow me again? Your devotion towards me is evident from the sincere concern expressed by you.
translations.hindi: वानरराज बीर बालि, उस सुवर्ण की स'ला का धारण करने से सन्ध्याकालीन मेघ की तरह शोभायमान हो रहा था
